subject.title: Feature Request: Gateway lifecycle hooks (onSubagentComplete, onToolCallThreshold, onTurnComplete)

question: Should OpenClaw expose subagent completion, turn completion, and tool-call threshold boundaries through HOOK.md workspace/internal hooks, typed plugin hooks only, or a split surface with different payload and authority levels?
rationale: The source gap is proven, but the correct API affects trusted local code execution, session-state exposure, hook ordering, possible threshold config, and the boundary between workspace automation and plugin middleware.

options.title: Split observation from control
options.body: Expose only minimal observation-oriented workspace events first, while keeping richer result, mutation, threshold, and policy behavior in typed plugin hooks.

options.title: Use typed plugin hooks only
options.body: Do not add new HOOK.md lifecycle events; instead extend the plugin API for lifecycle/receipt use cases that need stronger contracts.

options.title: Add the full workspace surface
options.body: Add subagent:ended, turn-complete, and threshold workspace events after maintainers define payload, ordering, redaction, and config semantics.

recommendation.title: Split observation from control
recommendation.body: Expose only minimal observation-oriented workspace events first, while keeping richer result, mutation, threshold, and policy behavior in typed plugin hooks.

likelyOwner.reason: This is primarily a product/security boundary choice, and steipete has adjacent hook/agent-core history plus direct discussion routing on this issue.
